## a) (2 pts) Use the lm( ) function in R to obtain the estimated regression function.
```{r a, include=TRUE}
lm1 <- lm(minutes ~ machines, data1)
summary(lm1)
```

## b) (3 pts) Using R as a calculator, obtain SSTO.
```{r b, include=TRUE}
# SSTO = summation((y(i) - y(hat))^2)
b1 = 14.7383
b0 = -2.3221
yhat <- b0 + b1*(data1$minutes)
e <- (data1$minutes)-yhat
yi <- b0 + (b1*(data1$machines)) + e
cbind(e, yi)
SSTO <- (yi - yhat)^2
SSTO <- sum(SSTO)
SSTO
```

## c) (3 pts) Using R as a calculator, obtain SSR. You can use the fitted values from the regression in (a).
```{r c, include=TRUE}
# SSR = sum((yhat - ybar)^2)
ybar <- mean(data1$minutes)
SSR <- (yhat - ybar)^2
SSR <- sum(SSR)
SSR
```
